note: Rustic campground under pines along the east shore of Trout Lake's north basin; the shore row (sites 1402-1414) faces the water through the trees. A large day-use water-access area with swimming, picnicking and a boat landing is a short walk south. The Heart of Vilas County paved bike trail and the North Trout Lake hiking trail start at the campground. --Claude

The brochure map puts the shore row (1414, 1412, 1410, 1408, 1407, 1406, 1404, 1403, 1402) west of the campground road along Trout Lake. On Esri (z18 and 760 m crops) and NAIP imagery the whole strip between the bike trail and the lake is continuous pine/hardwood canopy down to a narrow sand edge at the waterline; no pad or open ground within ~50 m of the water is visible, so an on-water value is not earned. The shore row supports a view (the brochure's sunset photo is taken through pines). The swimming/boat-landing area south of the campground is day use. Site photos are on GoingToCamp (refuses), so pads under the trees could not be measured.
